roxzone.notes: Jog every transition; know each station entrance beforehand

stations.strategy: 12.5 m continuous, 10 s breath at each line
Sit back, long pulls, walk it back when arms fade
Step down, step up, steady rhythm
Never stop; one step per second

taper.notes: Volume halves, race-pace touches stay. No heavy lunges or wall balls to failure inside 5 days.
